title: Halo Dental hero
description: Full-screen rounded black hero stage with a studio-lit vertical cylindrical hardware placeholder in the centre, a massive display wordmark anchored to the bottom-left on desktop, a clean tagline at the bottom-right, and a vermilion split-icon video button on mobile.
notes: forces .dark by default so the black studio backdrop and oversized white display type stay faithful inside a light page
media slot accepts a custom product render or video; defaults to a token-styled vertical cylindrical instrument silhouette
